iti102:2.1: (Cat.) Jānato-haṃ bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi, no ajānato apassato. Kiñca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti? Idaṃ dukkhan-ti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti. Evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti. Sekhassa sikkhamānassa ujumaggānusārino | khayasmiṃ
iti102:4.1: Tato aññā vimuttassa vimuttiññāṇam-uttamaṃ | uppajjati khaye ñāṇaṃ khīṇā saṃyojanā iti ||
iti102:5.1: Na tvevidaṃ kusītena bālena-m- avijānatā | nibbānaṃ adhigantabbaṃ sabbaganthapamocanan-ti ||3||
